topic: A chilled caramel latte with glossy cream and ice slowly stirred in a sunlit cafe close-up
prompt_goal: Create one satisfying cinematic ASMR-style single-video prompt focused on tactile detail, swirl motion, and premium coffee texture.
main_subject: A chilled caramel latte in a clear glass with glossy cream, ice cubes, and golden caramel shell texture.
setting: A clean sunlit cafe tabletop with soft reflections and premium coffee styling.
action: A hand gently cracks the caramel top, stirs the cream through the drink, and reveals slow swirling texture and condensation.
blocking_and_staging: Keep the glass centered, hand movements slow and precise, and the hero drink readable at every moment.
foreground_midground_background: Foreground highlights and condensation, latte in the midground, soft cafe blur in the background.
must_include: close-up texture, slow stir, satisfying crack, visible condensation
avoid: messy splashes, jittery hand motion, warped glass
